legacy_world_sizes.options.legacyBiomeSc: Select a Biome scale to change the amount of world space each Biome will take up. Larger scale usually means fewer, but larger, Biomes.
If you're creating a world with a random seed, this option looks for a world with a good mix of biomes. Disabling this may generate a world all of one Biome!
